runbooks.title: Standard Mitigation for Network Failure - Scenario 1
matching_symptoms: Secondary metric: Elevated latency during dns resolution timeout on route53
prerequisites: Root access or AWS SSO role ProdOperations
remediation_steps: Step 1: Drain traffic from degraded pods or instances for DNS
Step 2: Apply temporary rate-limit or failover to standby replica/pool
Step 3: Execute graceful restart via rolling deployment rollback
Step 4: Verify error rates drop below 0.1% for 5 consecutive minutes
runbooks.safety_notes: Do not terminate primary node without promoting read-replica first. Verify write freeze before reboot.
runbooks.verification_procedure: Check Grafana dashboard 'Core Microservices SLA' to ensure 2xx ratio >= 99.95%
